description: Source code implementing JSON Web Token (JWT) encoding, decoding, and signature validation within the Thunder namespace, including a class for JSON Web Data and functions for handling JWTs with SHA256 HMAC.

classes.name: JSONWebData
classes.description: Represents the JSON Web Data structure with 'typ' and 'alg' fields, used for JWT header information.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::JSONWebToken
methods.description: Constructor initializing JWT with a specified mode, key length, and key data, setting up the header.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a payload into a JWT token string, optionally signing with SHA256.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a JWT token string into payload data, verifying signature if applicable.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::ValidSignature
methods.description: Validates the signature of a JWT token based on the specified mode.

methods.name: JSONWebToken::PayloadLength
methods.description: Calculates the payload length from a JWT token string.
